English: Bear Skull Post
A humble wooden post adorned with the skull of a bear, marking sacred ground and rallying the clan in the wilds.
Stone Altar
A roughly-hewn stone altar for offerings to the Bear Spirit, strengthening unity and clan traditions.
Bear Hide Tent
A large tent crafted from bear hides, providing shelter for shamanic rites and a gathering point for the clan.
Bear Tooth Stand
A ceremonial stand displaying the teeth of honored bears, inspiring awe and reverence among the tribes.
Shamanic Shelter
A robust wooden shelter for shamans and spirit-keepers, providing guidance and unity for the bear-worshipping nomads.
Bear Spirit Hall
A great timber hall where the clan gathers for feasts, rituals, and judgments in the name of the Bear Spirit.
Totem Pavilion
A grand pavilion draped in sacred symbols and hides, housing totems and relics of the Bear Faith.
Bearkeepers Yurt
The yurt of the Bearkeeper, spiritual head and guardian, from which ritual and discipline flows across the clan.
Great Bear Shrine
A monumental wooden shrine decorated with bear carvings, the central seat of Finno-Ugric bear veneration.
Finno-Ugric Bear Sanctuary
The supreme sanctuary of the Bear Faith, where all Finno-Ugric clans gather to honor the Bear Spirit and forge unity.
